RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the February  13, 2009/Magha 24, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
1
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Sick small and medium
enterprises
†*1. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of MICRO, SMALL
AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at present
there are about 1.3 crore industrial units in
the country which are in small and medium
enterprises sector;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
this enterprises sector contributes about
40 per cent to the exports of the country;
and
(c) if not, the details of the actual
estimate and the number of units in this
sector which have become sick so far due
to international economic recession and the
amount proposed to be provided by banks
and other institutions to this sector to get
rid of this sickness?
Starvation in the country
†*2. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
International Food Policy Research
Institute has stated that 23 crore people
face starvation in India;
(b) last five years' official figures thereon
available with Government, State-wise
details thereof;
(c) whether this situation is likely to
further deteriorate in view of the current
economic scenario; and
(d) if so, the plan to tackle this problem?
Availability of fertilizers in the
country
*3. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has curbed

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
imports of fertilizers to keep fertilizer
subsidy within reasonable limits as the
international prices of fertilizers have gone
up by a factor of 2 to 3 times, resulting in a
steep increase in the quantum of fertilizer
subsidy;
(b) if so, whether this has resulted in a
shortage of fertilizers in the country and
led to violent agitation by farmers;
(c) whether fertilizer is being distributed
in some places from police stations; and
(d) what steps Government is taking to
ease farmers' problems in this regard?
Denial of treatment by CGHS
empanelled hospitals
*4. SHRI V ARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
multi-speciality hospitals in Delhi and
adjoining areas which had agreed to treat
C.G .H.S. card holders without payment
from beneficiaries at the time of treatment
and to recover it from Government, have
now discontinued that facility;
(b) if so, the names of the concerned
hospitals and the reasons for the
withdrawal of facility, thereby causing
hardship, particularly to pensioners; and
(c) the action proposed by Government
to restore the earlier arrangement?
Under-utilization of funds by
Himachal Pradesh
*5. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to refer
to answer to Unstarred Question 2114
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 19th
December, 2008 and to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Rs. 10.42
crore only has been utilized out of Rs. 71.03
crore allocated by Government for financial
year 2008-09 under National Rural Health
Mission (NRHM) by the Himachal Pradesh
Government;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether State Government of
Himachal Pradesh does not have any
planning to utilize the fund for achieving
the target of NRHM;
(d) if so, details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto; and
(e) whether Government has taken any
initiative to encourage such States which
are not implementing the scheme seriously
and do not come forward with good
scheme?
Conversion of wasteland into
cultivable land
†*6. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 17.45 per
cent of land is wasteland in the country;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard;
(c) the area of wasteland which has been
converted into agricultural land from 2006
to 2008; and
(d) the total area of wasteland targeted
to be converted into cultivable land during
the Eleventh Five Y ear Plan?
Closure of sugar mills
*7. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the price of

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
sugar has increased very fast during the
last 2-3 years due to closure of sugar mills;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government is taking in
this regard?
